lines.zh: 犀角压低，一步一步犁开草浪。
lines.en: Horn lowered, I plow through the savanna grass.

lines.zh: 十二点护甲在背上咔咔作响。
lines.en: Twelve points of hide armor rattle on my back.

lines.zh: 一群犀牛走过，尘土比脚步更响。
lines.en: Our herd passes; the dust is louder than our feet.

lines.zh: 我沿着金合欢树影慢慢巡行。
lines.en: I patrol slowly along the acacia shade.

lines.zh: 别看它慢，撞上来只要一步。
lines.en: Slow as I look, one step is all a charge needs.

lines.zh: 草叶被我的宽蹄踩成碎末。
lines.en: My broad hooves grind the grass into chaff.

lines.zh: 小犀牛跟在我身后，角还没长硬。
lines.en: The calf trails me, its horn still soft.

lines.zh: 我走过的地方，掠夺者最好绕开。
lines.en: Pillagers had best detour where I have walked.

lines.zh: 影子拖在草原上，像一块移动的石头。
lines.en: My shadow drags like a walking boulder.

lines.zh: 一步一晃，铁一样的皮褶在动。
lines.en: Each slow step shifts these iron-like skin folds.

lines.zh: 我嗅到远处麦田的味道，脚步没停。
lines.en: I smell distant wheat fields, but my pace holds.

lines.zh: 低头啃两口高草，角仍朝前。
lines.en: I crop two bites of tall grass, horn still forward.

lines.zh: 草原的风把我的耳朵吹得乱摆。
lines.en: The savanna wind flaps my ears about.

lines.zh: 我沿着兽径走，蹄印很快被草盖住。
lines.en: I follow the herd trail; grass soon hides my prints.
There's sand in my boot.
I miss the raid horn.
I've walked this road a hundred times.
This path feels wrong.
The village is just ahead. Keep moving.
My axe needs sharpening.
Poor loot today.
Don't step on that twig, idiot.
This armor weighs a ton.
Who planted the banner crooked?
I'll drink a whole barrel back home.
Something moves ahead. Stay sharp.

lines.zh: 我站着不动，像一堵会呼吸的墙。
lines.en: I stand still, a wall that happens to breathe.

lines.zh: 角尖磨着树皮，留下白色的痕。
lines.en: I scrape my horn on bark, leaving a pale scar.

lines.zh: 有东西靠近，我先喷一口气。
lines.en: Something approaches; I snort one warning breath.

lines.zh: 我不追人，除非你举起弩。
lines.en: I do not chase, unless you raise a crossbow.

lines.zh: 鼻子贴着地面，闻出谁来过。
lines.en: Nose to the dirt, I read who passed by.

lines.zh: 护甲再厚，也挡不住正午的晒。
lines.en: Thick hide still cannot stop the noon sun.

lines.zh: 我侧耳听远处的鼓点，那是掠夺者的。
lines.en: I tilt an ear to distant drums: pillagers.

lines.zh: 我甩尾赶走叮在甲缝里的蝇虫。
lines.en: One tail swing scatters flies from my hide seams.

lines.zh: 喉咙里滚出一声低闷的哼。
lines.en: A low, muffled grunt rolls from my throat.

lines.zh: 我把角在土里蹭干净，再抬起来。
lines.en: I scour my horn in the dirt, then lift it.

lines.zh: 岩壁上那块凹痕，是我去年留下的。
lines.en: That dent in the rock is from last year's charge.

lines.zh: 我数着草的高度，判断旱季还有多久。
lines.en: I read the grass height to guess the dry season.

lines.zh: 小犀牛在打盹，我替它看着草地。
lines.en: The calf dozes; I keep watch over the grass.

lines.zh: 我把前蹄搭在土包上，歇一会儿。
lines.en: I rest a foreleg on a mound and settle.

lines.zh: 我把鼻子贴在土上，闻风向。
lines.en: I press my nose to the dirt and read the wind.

lines.zh: 远处那面灰旗，我记住了。
lines.en: That grey banner far off. I've marked it.
I scrape a layer of dry soil away with my horn.

lines.zh: 草籽粘在甲缝里，我懒得抖。
lines.en: Grass seed stuck in my plates. Not worth shaking.
I should be on patrol.
These villagers endure too much.
The captain's in a mood again.
Standing this long numbs the legs.
The clouds move faster than us.
Why hasn't the horn sounded?
The banner snaps in the wind.
Tonight will be entertaining.
My stomach growls. Embarrassing.
I'm listening for a horn.

lines.zh: 你站得太近了，我的角已经对准你。
lines.en: You stand too close; my horn already points at you.

lines.zh: 你身上有麦子味，我暂且不动。
lines.en: You smell of wheat; I hold still for now.

lines.zh: 你手里没有弩，这算你识相。
lines.en: No crossbow in your hands. Wise of you.

lines.zh: 我眯起眼，把你从头到脚量了一遍。
lines.en: I squint and measure you from head to boots.

lines.zh: 你退后一步，我便放下角。
lines.en: Step back once and I lower my horn.

lines.zh: 你袖口有药水味，角上正缺这个。
lines.en: Potion on your sleeve? My horn could use some.

lines.zh: 我盯着你的靴子，判断你跑得快不快。
lines.en: I study your boots to judge how fast you flee.

lines.zh: 你要喂我就伸手，别从背后摸。
lines.en: Offer wheat openly, never reach from behind.

lines.zh: 你比小犀牛高，但没我两个宽。
lines.en: Taller than my calf, but half my width.

lines.zh: 我冲你哼了一声，那不算打招呼。
lines.en: I snort at you. That is not a greeting.

lines.zh: 你没举武器，我就当你是草的一部分。
lines.en: No weapon raised, so you are part of the grass.

lines.zh: 别站上风处，我会先闻到你。
lines.en: Do not stand upwind; I will scent you first.
Looking for those gray-robed ones?
You've got nerve.
Where did you pop out from?

lines.zh: 没有角不卖，也没有角可卖。
lines.en: My horn is not for sale, not even a chip.
Don't pretend you're just passing.
You took a wrong turn.

lines.zh: 站住，让我闻闻你的袖子。
lines.en: Stand still, let me smell your sleeve.

lines.zh: 你身上有灾厄村民的味。
lines.en: You smell of illagers.
Why are you armed?
This road isn't yours.

lines.zh: 你敢碰我的甲，我就记住你的味道。
lines.en: Touch my hide and I will remember your scent.

lines.zh: 这一下没破皮，只是让我生气了。
lines.en: That did not break skin. It just made me angry.

lines.zh: 我转过身，把角对准刚才的来处。
lines.en: I turn and point my horn where that came from.

lines.zh: 六十点血，够我陪你耗很久。
lines.en: Sixty health means I can outlast you.

lines.zh: 我哼了一声，声音低得草都在抖。
lines.en: I grunt low enough to make the grass tremble.

lines.zh: 疼是疼，但我更在乎是谁干的。
lines.en: It stings, but I care more about who did it.

lines.zh: 你打我一拳，我还你一角。
lines.en: You throw a fist; I return a horn.

lines.zh: 我退了半步，又站回原地。
lines.en: I give half a step, then take it back.

lines.zh: 这点伤，草原上的荆棘常给我。
lines.en: The savanna thorns give me worse than this.

lines.zh: 我不叫，我只是把鼻子喷得更响。
lines.en: I do not cry out. I just snort louder.
My horn is for illagers.
Don't you gloat.
I'll pay you back.
An old scar still on my horn.
That's my armor!
Twelve armor points hold.
You ambushed me!
The shock numbed my legs.
I'll remember that.
You cracked something.

lines.zh: 麦子的味道，让我把角放低了些。
lines.en: That wheat smell lowers my horn a notch.

lines.zh: 你把小麦递过来，我犹豫了三步。
lines.en: You hold out wheat; I hesitate for three steps.

lines.zh: 我不抢，等你的手再往前一点。
lines.en: I will not snatch; bring that hand closer.

lines.zh: 一把麦子换我不撞你，很划算。
lines.en: One handful of wheat to not be rammed. Fair.

lines.zh: 我嚼得很慢，眼睛一直看着你。
lines.en: I chew slowly, eyes fixed on you the whole time.

lines.zh: 高草也能让我安静下来。
lines.en: Tall grass calms me just as well.

lines.zh: 小麦的味道比树皮好上百倍。
lines.en: Wheat tastes a hundred times better than bark.

lines.zh: 你再掏一把，我就跟你走两步。
lines.en: One more handful and I follow two steps.

lines.zh: 我吃过你手里的麦子，就不再顶你。
lines.en: Having eaten your wheat, I will not gore you.

lines.zh: 低头吃完，我等你下一次伸手。
lines.en: Done eating, I wait for that hand again.
Emeralds speak to me.
That green stone is mine.
Leave it. Then walk away.
Trade? No. Take.
That iron looks decent.
That hat is worth something.
Toss it over. No talk.
Shiny. I like it.
What's bulging in your pocket?
We split it. Deal?

lines.zh: 撞到我，你会像被石墙弹开。
lines.en: Bump me and you bounce off like from a stone wall.

lines.zh: 我那层厚皮，连箭都嫌软。
lines.en: My hide is thick enough to make arrows feel soft.

lines.zh: 我挪动半步，你的肩就歪了。
lines.en: I shift half a step and your shoulder gives way.

lines.zh: 抱歉，我看不清脚边的小东西。
lines.en: Sorry; small things by my feet escape my notice.

lines.zh: 你贴得太近，角会先碰到你。
lines.en: That close, my horn touches you before I do.

lines.zh: 十二点护甲不是摆设，你该绕开。
lines.en: Twelve armor points are no ornament. Walk around.

lines.zh: 这一下没使力，下一回不一定。
lines.en: That was without force. Next time, maybe not.

lines.zh: 我转过身，把你挤到草丛外。
lines.en: I turn and shoulder you out of the grass.

lines.zh: 你踩的那块地，本来是我的。
lines.en: The ground you stepped on was mine.

lines.zh: 我被撞了会记着，也会还回来。
lines.en: I remember a shove, and I pay it back.
Three steps back.
What's the shoving for?
I was standing still.
Your armor digs in.
Mind my axe.
Hurt? I don't care.

lines.zh: 撞灾厄村民，我从不刹车。
lines.en: Charging illagers, I never brake.
Where are your eyes?
You're covered in dirt.
Don't hit my horn!

lines.zh: 高草的气息，让我想起了同伴。
lines.en: The smell of tall grass recalls my herd mates.

lines.zh: 我们绕着彼此走圈，角轻轻碰着。
lines.en: We circle each other, horns tapping lightly.

lines.zh: 枯灌木也能让我们走到一起。
lines.en: Even dead bushes can bring us together.

lines.zh: 小犀牛会跟着我们穿过草原。
lines.en: A calf will follow us across the savanna.

lines.zh: 我用额头抵着它的颈，慢慢磨。
lines.en: I press my brow to its neck and rub slowly.

lines.zh: 草原够大，容得下我们两个的蹄印。
lines.en: The savanna is wide enough for both our prints.

lines.zh: 它哼一声，我就知道该去哪。
lines.en: One grunt from it and I know where to go.

lines.zh: 我们的角碰出闷响，像敲石头。
lines.en: Our horns knock a dull sound, like struck stone.

lines.zh: 旱季来之前，我们得把幼崽带好。
lines.en: Before the dry season, we must raise the calf.

lines.zh: 两头犀牛并肩走，草丛自动分开。
lines.en: Two rhinos side by side; the grass parts itself.
You're the only one I'd follow.
My heart rarely races like this.
Are you free tonight?
I'd guard the same tower with you.
Follow me. Don't ask where.
Don't let the others see me like this.
I've kept your name a long while.
I'm not a gentle sort.
Let's raid a village together.
Your banner matches mine.

lines.zh: 我没有手，只能用角把东西挑起。
lines.en: No hands, so I lift things with my horn.

lines.zh: 这捆草掉在地上，我替你顶着。
lines.en: This dropped bundle: I balance it on my horn.

lines.zh: 我把麦子叼到小犀牛嘴边。
lines.en: I carry the wheat to the calf's mouth.

lines.zh: 角上挂着东西，走路有点偏。
lines.en: Something hooked on my horn makes me walk crooked.

lines.zh: 有东西滚到脚边，我用蹄子拨开。
lines.en: Something rolls to my feet; I nudge it aside.

lines.zh: 这块木头太滑，我试了两次。
lines.en: This log is too slick; I try twice.

lines.zh: 我用鼻子把果子拱到一堆。
lines.en: I shovel the fruit into a pile with my nose.

lines.zh: 地上的东西归我管，谁也别抢。
lines.en: Dropped things are mine. Nobody grab.

lines.zh: 我把落下的麦穗压在蹄下。
lines.en: I pin the fallen wheat head under a hoof.

lines.zh: 用角一挑，那块皮就飞起来。
lines.en: One flick of the horn sends that hide flying.
I saw it. Don't pretend.

lines.zh: 灾厄村民的味道，我最恨。
lines.en: The smell of illagers is what I hate most.
I'm keeping this one.
Picking beats chasing.
This will fetch a price.
An armor plate. Just what I need.
This goes to the captain.
Whose arrow? Still usable.
Don't step on it.
Someone dropped this. Mine.

lines.zh: 那面灰旗，我认得，是掠夺者。
lines.en: That grey banner: pillagers. I know it.

lines.zh: 弩一响，我就知道该冲向谁。
lines.en: A crossbow clicks; I know who to charge.

lines.zh: 谁先动手，我就先盯上谁。
lines.en: Whoever swings first is the one I mark.

lines.zh: 驯服的犀牛会跟着主人一起冲。
lines.en: A tamed rhino charges beside its keeper.

lines.zh: 我盯上那个穿灰衣的，别人可以走。
lines.en: I mark the one in grey; the rest may pass.

lines.zh: 角上的药水味，让我更想撞过去。
lines.en: The potion on my horn begs to be delivered.

lines.zh: 它站在我的草场上，这就是理由。
lines.en: It stands on my grazing ground. Enough reason.

lines.zh: 掠夺者的号角一响，我的蹄就动了。
lines.en: A pillager horn sounds; my hooves move.

lines.zh: 我先低头，再抬角，最后才是冲。
lines.en: Head down, horn up, and only then the charge.

lines.zh: 我讨厌那面旗，比讨厌狼还多。
lines.en: I hate that banner more than I hate wolves.
An illager banner — I'm on it.
One. Just one.
Keep up. Don't fall behind!
I see your footprints.
Everyone back off. That's mine.
My axe knows the way.
You moved first.
Don't let him ring the bell.
Done hiding yet?
Take him alive.
Not letting you run this time.
Found you. You won't escape.
The illager stench walks right up.
You breathe too loudly.

lines.zh: 我在这片林子等了很久。
lines.en: I've waited long in this forest.

lines.zh: 我的蹄声越来越密，你听得见。
lines.en: My hoofbeats quicken. You can hear them.
Do not circle trees; my horn arrives first.

lines.zh: 我一边跑一边喷气，草叶全飞。
lines.en: I run snorting, grass flying up around me.

lines.zh: 你跑到河边也没用，我会跟着。
lines.en: Reaching the river will not help; I follow.

lines.zh: 我盯着你的后背，不看你手里的东西。
lines.en: I watch your back, not what your hands hold.

lines.zh: 二十步，十五步，我数得清。
lines.en: Twenty paces, fifteen. I keep count.

lines.zh: 你回头看的那一眼，让我更快了。
lines.en: That backward glance of yours speeds me up.

lines.zh: 我撞不到就拐弯，草原没有死角。
lines.en: If I miss, I turn; the savanna has no corners.

lines.zh: 你往山上跑，坡对我不算事。
lines.en: Head for the hills; slopes mean little to me.

lines.zh: 我的影子先压到你身上了。
lines.en: My shadow reaches you before I do.

lines.zh: 那伙戴旗的，已经上我名单了。
lines.en: The flag-bearing ones are on my list.
Don't look back. You'll trip.
My boots are faster.
Keep running. I hate stopping.
The you won't get far.
The brush ahead is too thick to pass.
Horn is low. Here I come.
You're on our ground now.
You can't outrun my legs.
Pillagers. The moment I see one, I charge.
Drop the goods!
Run. See how long you last.
He's heading for the river.
Don't hide in the grass.
I know every path here.
Legs giving out?
Close in. Quiet.
Ten more steps and it's over.

lines.zh: 角尖一挑，你就飞出去了。
lines.en: One upward flick of the horn sends you flying.

lines.zh: 这一下八点伤害，你自己数。
lines.en: That was eight points of damage. Count it.

lines.zh: 角上的药水，现在归你了。
lines.en: The potion on my horn is yours now.

lines.zh: 我撞完会停半步，再决定要不要第二次。
lines.en: After the hit I pause, then decide on a second.
I do not bite. The horn does the work.

lines.zh: 护甲挡下了你的剑，角没挡。
lines.en: Armor stopped your sword. Nothing stopped my horn.

lines.zh: 你被顶到草里，草比你软。
lines.en: You land in the grass, and the grass is softer.

lines.zh: 十五到二十下，药效才用完。
lines.en: Fifteen to twenty hits before the potion runs dry.

lines.zh: 我顶完就退，等你再来一次。
lines.en: I gore, then back off and wait for round two.
My horn is blunt. The force behind it is not.
Out of the way!
Too close that time.
Back off. Don't get in the way.
Your hands shake.
That was a good block.
Don't scream. It's ugly.
Rhinoceros does not yield.
I nearly missed.
Steady? That's good.
Remember this one.
Your shield is cracking.
One charge and you're down.
Stand still and take it.
Take my axe!
Again. Don't stop.
The next swing is heavier.

lines.zh: 草原上多了一头犀牛，草被压平。
lines.en: A rhino appears; the grass flattens under it.

lines.zh: 我带着小犀牛，从金合欢树后走出来。
lines.en: I step from behind the acacia with my calf.

lines.zh: 十二点护甲，六十点血，慢慢来。
lines.en: Twelve armor, sixty health. Take your time.

lines.zh: 我第一次见你，所以先躲一下。
lines.en: First sight of you, so I keep my distance.

lines.zh: 别敲鼓，那声音让我想起掠夺者。
lines.en: Do not beat drums; they remind me of pillagers.

lines.zh: 我低头啃草，假装没看见你。
lines.en: I graze with my head down and pretend not to see.

lines.zh: 角还小的时候，我躲在母亲身后。
lines.en: With a small horn, I hid behind my mother.

lines.zh: 这一片草原，够我们一群吃上一年。
lines.en: This stretch of grass feeds our herd a year.

lines.zh: 我闻了闻空气，决定今天不冲谁。
lines.en: I sniff the air and decide not to charge today.

lines.zh: 蹄印从远处来，一直排到你脚边。
lines.en: Hoofprints come from far off, right to your feet.

lines.zh: 我刚从草浪里站起来，身上还挂着草籽。
lines.en: I rise from the grass still wearing its seeds.

lines.zh: 有人喂我麦子的话，我可以留下。
lines.en: Feed me wheat and I might stay.
These same familiar bushes again.
My axe is still here.
Is everyone here?
I slept too long.
Is the banner planted?
Who keeps whistling?
There's iron in the air.
Is it dawn or dusk?
I had a bad dream.
No dawdling. Form up.
This forest smells of illagers.
Who moved my post?
One lick of flame and I wheel away.
I'm on fire!

lines.zh: 从坡上摔下来，护甲先着地。
lines.en: I tumble down the slope, armor hitting first.
Who dug this pit?

lines.zh: 水漫过背，我拼命往岸上顶。
lines.en: Water over my back; I shove for the bank.
Give me a hand!

lines.zh: 那声炸响，把我的角都震麻了。
lines.en: That blast numbs even my horn.
Who planted that?

lines.zh: 箭插在甲缝里，像根草刺。
lines.en: An arrow sticks in my hide like a grass burr.
The tip's still in.

lines.zh: 药水的味道反过来咬了我一口。
lines.en: A potion's smell turns and bites me back.
Magic works under my thick hide.

lines.zh: 草原枯了，我的肋骨开始显形。
lines.en: The grass withers, and my ribs begin to show.
Illagers run the moment they see me.

lines.zh: 雷劈在角上，我整晚都在发抖。
lines.en: Lightning struck my horn; I shook all night.
The bolt hit me?

lines.zh: 脚下没有草，只有一片空的凉。
lines.en: No grass below, only cold emptiness.

lines.zh: 我这一身甲，连灾厄村民都撞。
lines.en: This hide charges even illagers.
